records.statement: Elliptic's latest public holdings snapshot is approximately 04:30 UTC on 2026-10-31 and reports 233M XRP unchanged at that cutoff. No raw XRPL account_info and complete transaction-history verification was executed at the 10:45 UTC research cutoff. Do not describe the receiver as currently unchanged.

Binance's 12-hour initial PoR snapshot target calculated to 07:33 UTC and had elapsed by 10:45 UTC; no public result was located in this run. Binance's official announcement states results by 2026-11-02, while CoinDesk reports a November 1 reserve snapshot. Actual snapshot execution and publication remain unreconciled.

CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR crosswalk is Ethereum-specific. It does not prove that any of the five XRPL incident source wallets are included in Binance's October 1 XRP reserve address set. No official five-wallet XRP PoR crosswalk has been completed.

TraderTraitor/DPRK attribution remains Elliptic's private-sector assessment, not a government or law-enforcement determination. Elliptic notes the Bitget laundering overlap is small and the slow stablecoin conversion is atypical of prior DPRK-linked behavior.

Elliptic reports attacker use of Circle CCTP after converting stolen AVAX to USDC. CCTP is a public protocol route; no evidence shows Circle knew of, authorized or assisted the attacker. Do not create a Circle-attacker relationship beyond protocol service use.

Main still contains a scheduled Cross Analysis direct writer, a Scheduler Tick with contents:write and actions:write that can dispatch any existing workflow file, and the unsafe Databricks token-rotation workflow. PRs #1404, #1405 and #1407 passed exact-head CI and fail-closed gates but remain draft and unmerged; main is not fixed.

PR #1406 verifies a strict outcome timestamp contract but does not implement model training, historical feature ingestion, leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation, calibrated probabilities, drift detection or paper/shadow evaluation. It remains draft and unmerged; no forecast is issued.

The nine-platform capability map remains design-only for external providers. ChatGPT and GitHub access are verified; Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle and Databricks have not been authenticated or tested as live collaborators. No external handoff is verified.
